instruction: The earthquake struck 50 km southwest of Tokyo, near the coast of Sagami Bay.
A wildfire was reported 15 km north of Los Angeles, spreading towards the San Gabriel Mountains.
Flooding hit the area 30 km east of Mumbai along the Ulhas River basin.
The tsunami warning was issued for the coastal zone between Sendai and Fukushima, approximately at the midpoint.
A 6.2 magnitude earthquake struck 80 km at a bearing of 210 degrees from Santiago, Chile.
The hurricane made landfall 25 km southeast of New Orleans and moved 40 km northeast over the next 6 hours.
Volcanic eruption reported 12 km south of Reykjavik. Evacuation zone extends 5 km further south from the eruption site.
The landslide occurred at a point roughly one-third of the way from Kathmandu to Pokhara along the Prithvi Highway.
Flash floods affected the area between Cairo and Alexandria. Emergency response was set up at the midpoint, then shifted 10 km west due to road access.
The epicenter was located 65 km at a bearing of 135 degrees from Ankara. Aftershocks were felt 20 km northwest of the epicenter.
